metadata.method: Random sampling of NDVI pixel centroids (10m Sentinel-2 native) reprojected UTM21S to WGS84, density-weighted
metadata.caveat: Tree positions are ESTIMATED from NDVI density, NOT measured crowns. Real tree locations require drone survey or Wes photo captures. NDVI sees canopy density, not individual tree positions - each point represents ~10m x 10m of forest. The visual rendering shows DISTRIBUTION, not exact placement.
